content.value_statement: Teams often create documents with inconsistent colors, fonts, layouts, and tone. This skill applies Acme brand standards and checks content for compliance before delivery.
actual_capabilities: Applies Acme color, font, layout, header, footer, and chart standards to document configuration plans.
Formats Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF configuration dictionaries with predefined brand styles.
Validates color, font, tone, and brand name usage against configurable guidelines.
Calculates a brand compliance score with violations, warnings, and suggestions.
Provides reference guidance for accessibility, file naming, department rules, and regional formats.
limitations: Default rules use Acme Corporation sample branding and must be customized for real organizations.
The Python helpers return configuration objects and do not directly edit binary Office or PDF files.
Color matching uses simple exact checks and limited closest-color suggestions.
Tone validation is keyword based and cannot replace human brand review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Executive Presentations
use_cases.description: Apply approved colors, title areas, footer rules, chart palettes, and bullet styles before leadership review.

use_cases.title: Check Client Reports Before Delivery
use_cases.description: Validate colors, fonts, brand name capitalization, and tone to find issues before sending documents externally.

use_cases.title: Build Repeatable Document Templates
use_cases.description: Create reusable configuration patterns for Excel workbooks, PDF reports, and PowerPoint decks.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Brand Formatting
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Acme brand guidelines to this report outline. Use approved colors, fonts, headings, and footer rules.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Draft Content
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before sharing a draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft for brand compliance. Check colors, fonts, tone, brand name usage, and prohibited wording.

prompt_templates.title: Create Multi-Format Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Create brand-compliant formatting plans for a PowerPoint deck, Excel summary, and PDF report using the same campaign content.

prompt_templates.title: Customize Guidelines for a Team
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced adaptation for a specific organization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt the sample brand rules to our organization. Replace colors, fonts, tone keywords, prohibited words, and document standards.

output_examples.input: A quarterly business review deck with mixed colors and unstyled charts.
output_examples.output: A branded presentation plan with Acme Blue title bars, approved chart colors, Segoe UI typography, logo placement, and consistent footers.

output_examples.input: A report draft using Comic Sans, red headings, and informal language.
output_examples.output: A compliance review that flags unapproved fonts, unapproved colors, and tone issues, with clear replacement suggestions.

output_examples.input: An Excel dashboard configuration for sales metrics.
output_examples.output: A formatted workbook plan with blue header rows, navy body text, alternating light rows, approved borders, and chart palette guidance.

best_practices: Replace the sample Acme rules with current brand assets before using the skill for production work.
Validate important documents after formatting so visual changes and messaging stay aligned.
Keep approved color, font, logo, and tone lists small enough for consistent use.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the sample Acme brand as a universal corporate style guide.
Do not rely on keyword tone checks as the only review for sensitive communications.
Do not use generated configuration plans without verifying them in the final document tool.

faq.question: What document types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It provides formatting guidance and helper logic for Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF document configurations.

faq.question: Can I use my own brand instead of Acme?
faq.answer: Yes. Update the colors, fonts, tone keywords, prohibited words, logo rules, and document standards.

faq.question: Does it directly modify Office files?
faq.answer: No. The included helpers produce configuration data and validation results for other document generation workflows.

faq.question: Does it check accessibility?
faq.answer: The reference includes contrast and minimum font size guidance, but automated accessibility testing is limited.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I review manually?
faq.answer: Review final layout, logo quality, legal text, regional formats, and tone for high-visibility documents.
